description: This file defines the LtPredicateImpl class, which represents a 'less than' predicate in a query criteria API within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract predicate class and implements an accept method for visitor pattern processing.

classes.name: LtPredicateImpl
classes.description: Represents a 'less than' predicate used in query criteria, supporting visitor pattern.

methods.name: LtPredicateImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the predicate with a comparison value.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor and delegates the 'less than' visit passing its stored value.
